references.text: A parallel law text in Deuteronomy listing the same unclean birds: the owl, the little owl, and the barn owl are mentioned as unclean birds that Israelites must not eat.
Isaiah mentions the pelican and the owl as dwelling in desolate Edom, showing how these unclean birds were associated with destruction and abandonment.
Zephaniah prophesies that owls will dwell in the ruined buildings of Nineveh, using these unclean birds as symbols of destruction.
The psalmist compares himself to a pelican in the wilderness and an owl among ruins, using these unclean birds as images of loneliness and sorrow.
